name: Abbey Sharp
who: Registered Dietitian (Toronto), runs Abbey's Kitchen media brand, host of the Bite Back podcast.
why: One of the longest-running, highest-production RD channels online; myth-busting videos and a bestselling book give her outsized field visibility.
reach: IG 426K (verified 2026-08); also active on YouTube and TikTok

name: Steph Grasso
who: Registered Dietitian, clinically trained, now a full-time TikTok/Instagram recipe-and-nutrition-education creator.
why: One of the highest-reach RDs on TikTok, credited with popularizing the fast, credentialed grocery-haul/recipe format many other dietitians now copy.

name: Kylie Sakaida
who: Registered Dietitian and NYT-bestselling cookbook author behind the nutritionbykylie brand.
why: Among the largest personal-following RDs on Instagram; cookbook and recipe content sets a reference bar for RD-led food media.

name: Wendy Lopez & Jessica Jones
who: Two Registered Dietitians who co-host the long-running Food Heaven Made Easy podcast and brand.
why: Early, decade-plus voices in diet-culture-critical, culturally inclusive nutrition media; influenced the current wave of anti-diet RD podcasters.
reach: IG approx. 140K, podcast running 10+ years (approx, unverified 2026-08)

name: Christy Harrison
who: Registered Dietitian, MPH, Certified Eating Disorders Specialist (CEDS); journalist turned intuitive-eating coach and author.
why: Her book Anti-Diet is widely cited as a movement-defining text; long-running Food Psych / Rethinking Wellness podcasts shaped anti-diet nutrition media.
reach: Podcast + Substack audience in the tens of thousands (approx, unverified 2026-08)

name: Colleen Christensen
who: Registered Dietitian behind the No Food Rules brand, focused on flexible, non-restrictive eating content.
why: Consistent, high-volume recipe and mindset content with a large, engaged following among mainstream (non-diet) nutrition audiences.

name: Nichole Andrews
who: Registered Dietitian specializing in oncology nutrition, working directly with cancer patients as the "Dietitian Cancer Coach."
why: Fills a genuine clinical-education gap: credentialed, practice-based guidance for cancer patients navigating nutrition myths during treatment.

name: Maya Feller
who: Maya Feller, MS, RD, CDN; runs a Brooklyn private practice and is a regular nutrition expert on Good Morning America.
why: Combines an active clinical practice with mainstream broadcast reach and a culturally-rooted nutrition book, a rare full-stack profile.

name: Vanessa Rissetto
who: MS, RDN; co-founder and CEO of Culina Health, a large multi-dietitian telehealth practice, and still sees patients herself.
why: Built one of the largest RD-led care practices in the US, scaling credentialed 1:1 nutrition care rather than just content.

name: Dawn Jackson Blatner
who: RDN, CSSD; former Chicago Cubs team dietitian, now a private-practice dietitian and regular Today Show/GMA nutrition contributor.
why: Two-decade media career plus an elite-sports practice history; her Flexitarian Diet book shaped mainstream plant-forward eating advice.

name: Shyla Cadogan
who: Registered Dietitian based in Washington, DC, with a private practice and frequent contributor role for national health outlets.
why: Steady media-dietitian output translating clinical nutrition into consumer-press guidance.

name: Rhiannon Lambert
who: BSc, MSc, Registered Nutritionist (RNutr); founder of the Rhitrition clinic in London and Sunday Times bestselling author.
why: The UK's highest-profile registered nutritionist, running an actual multi-practitioner clinic alongside books and two podcasts.

name: Lyndi Cohen
who: Accredited Practising Dietitian (APD) and Accredited Nutritionist; "The Nude Nutritionist," TV nutritionist on Australia's Today Show.
why: Leading Australian anti-diet dietitian voice with a TEDx talk, podcast, and coaching programs reaching a large binge-eating-recovery audience.

name: Susie Burrell
who: Accredited Practising Dietitian; former dietitian to NRL clubs Parramatta Eels and St George Illawarra Dragons, now a remote-consulting dietitian.
why: Twelve years as Sunrise's resident dietitian plus a podcast with 3M+ downloads make her one of Australia's most established mainstream nutrition voices.

name: Rebecca Gawthorne
who: Accredited Practising Dietitian, founder of the Nourish Naturally brand.
why: One of the largest Instagram followings of any credentialed dietitian worldwide, built on consistent non-diet, family-nutrition content.

name: Abby Langer
who: Registered Dietitian, private practice in Toronto and long-time nutrition writer for outlets like Self and Glamour.
why: Known for plain-spoken, myth-debunking commentary that pushes back on wellness-industry overreach from inside the profession.

name: Bonnie Taub-Dix
who: RDN, CDN; founder of BTD Nutrition Consultants and author of Read It Before You Eat It; longtime national media spokesperson for the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics.
why: Three-decade mainstream media career built consumer nutrition-label literacy at national scale, ahead of the current creator wave.

name: Keri Glassman
who: Registered Dietitian, founder of the Nutritious Life brand and a coach-certification program that trains other nutrition professionals.
why: Built a practice-plus-media-plus-training brand model that predates and influenced today's dietitian-influencer business playbook.
